high_level_description: A quiet two-storey Renaissance cloister in Valencia with rows of slender white marble columns and round arches around a sunny courtyard.

style_description.aesthetics: Warm, inviting vintage travel-poster illustration of Valencia, Spain; simple confident shapes, gentle grain, uncluttered composition, no lettering, no signs with words, no captions, no user interface.
style_description.lighting: Bright Mediterranean light with soft warm shadows.
style_description.art_style: Mid-century gouache travel poster with flat layered shapes, visible brush texture and a limited warm palette.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A square courtyard paved in pale stone under a deep blue sky, enclosed by two tiers of arcades.

elements.desc: An upper gallery of small round arches on thin white marble columns with a stone balustrade.
A lower arcade of larger round arches on white marble columns, with deep cool shadow behind.
A white marble statue of a seated bishop on a pedestal in the middle of the courtyard.
A man in his fifties in a linen jacket, a university professor, standing with a book under his arm.
